gecko.visible_surface_material: ceramic or tile shard with textured glaze
gecko.visible_surface_condition: irregular geometry, slightly rough and textured surface
evidence_used: limited parallel sidewalls for gecko pad attachment
gecko.calculation_summary: Force estimated based on compromised gecko dry adhesion due to surface texture and irregular shape, scaling up towards moderate-high force to compensate for weak directional contact.
assumptions_and_uncertainty: Zero-shot visual estimation without authoritative mass or roughness measurement
Assumes object can be grasped despite suboptimal geometry
gecko.reasoning_trace: The gecko gripper relies heavily on clean, smooth, flat surfaces for broad dry adhesive contact. The visible shard features an irregular, textured surface and non-parallel sides, which significantly degrades gecko performance and requires a higher normal force to maintain a stable grip.

evidence_used: high-friction silicone pad compatibility with textured surfaces
flat profile of the shard suitable for parallel jaw clamping
silicone.calculation_summary: Force estimated by leveraging high-friction silicone interface properties on a moderately textured ceramic material.
assumptions_and_uncertainty: Visual approximation of weight and contact area
Assumes rigid backing makes adequate contact along the shard edge
silicone.reasoning_trace: Silicone pads tolerate surface texture better than gecko pads because holding capacity arises from friction and local viscoelastic deformation. Consequently, a lower normal force is required compared to the gecko gripper.

comparison_evidence: The shard's textured and irregular surface reduces dry adhesion effectiveness for the gecko gripper.
The silicone gripper handles texture and irregular geometries better through frictional and viscoelastic interactions, requiring less normal force.
recommendation_summary: The silicone gripper is recommended because its high-friction pads are better suited for the textured and irregular surface of the ceramic shard, requiring a lower estimated normal force than the gecko gripper.
